entries.en: BUG & Fix
entries.zh: 缺陷与修复

entries.en: Maintenance
entries.zh: 维护性改动

entries.en: What's Changed
entries.zh: 本版变更

entries.en: feat: add EasyTier outbound (#3194)
entries.zh: 新功能：新增 EasyTier 出站（去中心化组网）

entries.en: feat: support `identity-secret` for ZeroTier
entries.zh: 新功能：ZeroTier 支持 `identity-secret`（身份内嵌、不落盘）

entries.en: feat: support `stack: mips` in tun configuration
entries.zh: 新功能：TUN 支持 `stack: mips`（mihomo 自研用户态 IP 栈）

entries.en: feat: support AmneziaWG v3.1
entries.zh: 新功能：支持 AmneziaWG v3.1

entries.en: fix: DomainSet wildcard matching with overlapping rules
entries.zh: 修复：DomainSet 通配规则重叠时的匹配错误

entries.en: fix: RandomPaddingAddition and DisableCookies for AmneziaWG v3
entries.zh: 修复：AmneziaWG v3 的 RandomPaddingAddition 与 DisableCookies

entries.en: fix: avoid VLESS decryption cleanup panic (#3195)
entries.zh: 修复：VLESS 解密清理时的 panic

entries.en: fix: close connection after error handling in doq
entries.zh: 修复：doq 出错后未关闭连接

entries.en: fix: close connection after error handling in handleContextListener
entries.zh: 修复：handleContextListener 出错后未关闭连接

entries.en: fix: close connection after error handling in kcptun
entries.zh: 修复：kcptun 出错后未关闭连接

entries.en: fix: close connection after error handling in mkcp outbound
entries.zh: 修复：mkcp 出站出错后未关闭连接

entries.en: fix: close connection after error handling in snell outbound
entries.zh: 修复：Snell 出站出错后未关闭连接

entries.en: fix: close connection after error handling in tuic server
entries.zh: 修复：TUIC 服务端出错后未关闭连接

entries.en: fix: close udp endpoint in mieru server
entries.zh: 修复：mieru 服务端未关闭 UDP 端点

entries.en: fix: correct android amd64 core asset name in updater (#3167)
entries.zh: 修复：更新器里 Android amd64 内核包名写错

entries.en: fix: error using of safeConnClose in sudoku outbound
entries.zh: 修复：sudoku 出站里 safeConnClose 的使用错误

entries.en: fix: handle decryption handshake errors in server
entries.zh: 修复：服务端解密握手错误未被处理

entries.en: fix: hysteria2 UDP sessions not closed on connection close
entries.zh: 修复：连接关闭时 Hysteria2 的 UDP 会话未关闭

entries.en: fix: initialize DNS before NTP (#3103)
entries.zh: 修复：NTP 之前需先初始化 DNS

entries.en: fix: ipv6 url parse in xhttp (#3160)
entries.zh: 修复：xhttp 的 IPv6 地址解析错误

entries.en: fix: mieru listener doesn't obey "listen" config (#3205)
entries.zh: 修复：mieru 入站未遵守 `listen` 配置

entries.en: fix: missing NeedHandshake for shadowsocks none
entries.zh: 修复：Shadowsocks none 缺少 NeedHandshake 标记

entries.en: fix: openvpn derive the tls-auth HMAC digest from auth instead of hard-coding SHA-1 (#3189)
entries.zh: 修复：OpenVPN 的 tls-auth HMAC 摘要改为按 auth 推导，不再硬编码 SHA-1

entries.en: fix: potential race condition in c.idleSession.Len() in idleCleanupExpTime() for anytls (#3225)
entries.zh: 修复：anytls 出站空闲会话清理中的竞态（c.idleSession.Len()）

entries.en: fix: preserve domain rules across Foreach round trips
entries.zh: 修复：DomainSet 遍历（Foreach）往返过程中域名规则丢失

entries.en: fix: prevent nil pointer dereference in WireGuard initialization (#3148)
entries.zh: 修复：WireGuard 初始化时的空指针解引用

entries.en: fix: restore hysteria v1 udp handling (#3178)
entries.zh: 修复：恢复 Hysteria v1 的 UDP 处理

entries.en: fix: set udp InUser metadata for mieru inbound (#3236)
entries.zh: 修复：mieru 入站未设置 UDP 的 InUser 元数据

entries.en: fix: split-DNS UDP queries fail silently in tsnet mode when upstream is a tailnet peer
entries.zh: 修复：tsnet 模式下上游是 tailnet 对端时，split-DNS 的 UDP 查询静默失败

entries.en: fix: tailscale should always use UserDial for upstream TCP DNS server
entries.zh: 修复：Tailscale 对上游 TCP DNS 服务器应始终使用 UserDial

entries.en: fix: trusttunnel client not waiting for TCP connection established
entries.zh: 修复：TrustTunnel 客户端未等待 TCP 连接建立

entries.en: fix: typo in config.yaml (#3145)
entries.zh: 修复：config.yaml 中的拼写错误

entries.en: fix: restart EasyTier outbound after silent overlay failure (#3215)
entries.zh: 修复：EasyTier 出站在 overlay 静默失败后自动重启

entries.en: chore: OpenVPN no longer relies on the underlying conn deadline functions
entries.zh: 维护：OpenVPN 不再依赖底层连接的 deadline 函数

entries.en: chore: add new DomainMap implement based on succinct DomainSet
entries.zh: 维护：新增基于 succinct DomainSet 的 DomainMap 实现

entries.en: chore: add some benchmark code for new DomainMap
entries.zh: 维护：为新 DomainMap 补充基准测试代码

entries.en: chore: add standalone DomainSetBuilder
entries.zh: 维护：抽出独立的 DomainSetBuilder

entries.en: chore: align the APIs between mipstack and gvisor
entries.zh: 维护：对齐 mipstack 与 gvisor 的 API

entries.en: chore: avoid a separate rule slice in DumpMrs
entries.zh: 维护：DumpMrs 中不再额外分配规则切片

entries.en: chore: avoid redundant rank calculations in DomainSet
entries.zh: 维护：DomainSet 中去除冗余的 rank 计算

entries.en: chore: avoid redundant select calculations in DomainSet
entries.zh: 维护：DomainSet 中去除冗余的 select 计算

entries.en: chore: buffer geodata reads with a 16 KiB reader (#3185)
entries.zh: 维护：geodata 读取改用 16 KiB 缓冲

entries.en: chore: change yaml library to go.yaml.in/yaml/v3
entries.zh: 维护：YAML 库换为 go.yaml.in/yaml/v3

entries.en: chore: convert support REALITY ML-KEM option (#3199)
entries.zh: 维护：convert 功能支持 REALITY 的 ML-KEM 选项

entries.en: chore: convert support xhttp `extra.headers` (#3230)
entries.zh: 维护：convert 功能支持 xhttp 的 `extra.headers`

entries.en: chore: improve mipstack under device backpressure
entries.zh: 维护：改善 mipstack 在设备背压下的表现

entries.en: chore: reduce connection memory and actor stack overhead for mipstack
entries.zh: 维护：降低 mipstack 的连接内存与 actor 栈开销

entries.en: chore: reduce gVisor memory usage
entries.zh: 维护：降低 gVisor 内存占用

entries.en: chore: reduce memory usage in converter (#3159)
entries.zh: 维护：降低转换器的内存占用

entries.en: chore: report detailed errors for invalid Clash-style domain patterns
entries.zh: 维护：非法的 Clash 风格域名规则现在会报详细错误

entries.en: chore: reuse queues during DomainSet build
entries.zh: 维护：DomainSet 构建期间复用队列

entries.en: chore: sharing synthetic datasets used for build benchmarking
entries.zh: 维护：共享构建基准测试所用的合成数据集

entries.en: chore: support lazy receive buffer reads for mipstack and gvisor
entries.zh: 维护：mipstack 与 gvisor 支持惰性接收缓冲读取

entries.en: chore: update mieru version (#3119)
entries.zh: 维护：更新 mieru 版本

entries.en: chore: update mipstack for api adjustment
entries.zh: 维护：因 API 调整而更新 mipstack

entries.en: chore: update tailscale to v1.102.3
entries.zh: 维护：Tailscale 升级到 v1.102.3

entries.en: chore: updated sudoku to v0.5.0 (#3187)
entries.zh: 维护：sudoku 升级到 v0.5.0
